title: Deleting a part that reached a work order meanwhile is refused
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919), with 'Part Library & Inventory → View / Create & Edit / Delete' and See Financial Data.
  • A second browser tab is open on the same site, signed in as the same Admin at {Location-A}.
  • Part {Part-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-DELRACE-01) is stocked at {Location-A} and is on no work order.
  • Work order {Work-order-1} (for example S2-15443) has a line, {Line-1} (for example "Replace - Brake pot"), with no part on it.
custom_steps:
1. In tab 1, type {Part-A} in the Inventory search.
  2. In tab 1, click the {Part-A} row.
  3. Leave that window open in tab 1. Do not close it.
  4. In tab 2, open {Work-order-1}.
  5. In tab 2, click ⋮ on {Line-1}.
  6. In tab 2, click Request part.
  7. In tab 2, pick the {Part-A} result that shows an Inventory Qty.
  8. In tab 2, take 1 from its bin.
  9. In tab 2, click Save Part.
  10. In tab 1, click Delete Part.
  11. In tab 1, close the window.
  12. In tab 1, type {Part-A} in the search.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 10: the delete is refused with a red message "Inventory part that has a work order part cannot be deleted.", with the second, smaller line "Please try to resolve this." It goes away after about 3 seconds. No other error message appears.
  • Step 12: {Part-A} is still listed.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; story SV-10826 (Story 13, The Part Dialog); PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, as edited 9 Oct 2026 (Ready for dev), S13-N6, §8 User Feedback Summary, read 13 Oct 2026; design canvas board 2.1 (The part as it stands), 13 Oct copy. Source-verified 13 October 2026; not yet build-verified (no Part Lifecycle QA build exists).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S13-N6: “If Delete Part reaches the system while the part sits on a work order, or has a return or credit that is not completed, the delete is refused with "Inventory part that has a work order part cannot be deleted." or "Inventory part with an open return or a pending credit cannot be deleted." Only that message is shown.”
  • PRD §8 User Feedback Summary (Delete refused, part on a work order): “"Inventory part that has a work order part cannot be deleted." | Error toast, fades after 3 seconds”
  • PRD §8 User Feedback Summary context note: “every refusal sent by the system, the rows that fade after 3 seconds, also shows a second, smaller line under the message: "Please try to resolve this."”
